title: Annual Report of the Riverside Allotment Society

headings.text: Annual Report of the Riverside Allotment Society

key_sentences: The society ended the year with 63 members, five more than last year.
Eleven people are still on the waiting list for a plot.
Income from plot rents was 3,150 pounds, and expenses came to 2,870 pounds.
The surplus will be kept as a reserve for repairing the water pipes.
Inspections took place in June and September.
Four plot holders received a written reminder to clear weeds from the paths.
The committee proposes to build a shared tool shed near the main gate.
Members will vote on the proposal at the spring meeting.
